propositions: ADR corpus contains 91 files with 69 distinct numbers; 17 numbers are duplicated across 22 files, causing collision ambiguity.

Per-number marker files in docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN (content = filename) enforce git-level conflict detection for same-number submissions, preventing race conditions that pre-merge CI checks cannot catch.
CI gate scripts/check_adr_numbers.py validates bijection between ADRs and markers, checks for unique numbers and marker content, and asserts referential integrity of all adr/NNNN-slug cross-links.
Twenty-two duplicate-numbered ADRs are renumbered to 0070-0091 in ascending landing-date order; earliest-landed ADR of each collision group retains its original number.
All slug-bearing cross-references to moved ADRs across docs/ and src/ are rewritten to their new 0070-0091 numbers and recorded in docs/adr/RENUMBERING.md with per-reference resolution tiers.

Generated docs/adr/README.md index organizes all 91 ADRs by workstream and full slug; docs/adr/RENUMBERING.md records old-to-new mapping and resolution table including the single unresolvable bare-number reference.
